words.gloss: in the wasted and the injured

hindi: दूध सभी प्राणियों के लिए सात्म्य है, शमन करने वाला और शोधन करने वाला भी है, प्यास बुझाने वाला और अग्नि को दीप्त करने वाला है, तथा क्षीण और क्षत रोगियों के लिए श्रेष्ठ है।
english: (Milk) is wholesome (sātmya) for all living beings, both pacifying (śamana) and purifying (śodhana), thirst-quenching and appetising (dīpanīya), and the best thing for the wasted and the injured (kṣīṇa-kṣata).

text_flags.why: possible typo: the compound is prāṇa-bhṛt 'bearer of breath'; a long ā before bhṛ has no grammatical basis; syllable count is the same either way

notes: Subject 'milk' (payaḥ/kṣīra) is carried over from the preceding verses. kṣīṇa-kṣata may mean 'those wasted and those with (chest) injury' or a single class 'wasted from chest injury (urakṣata)'; taken here as dvandva.
lines_deva: तृष्णाघ्नं दीपनीयं च श्रेष्ठं क्षीणक्षतेषु च
lines_iast: tṛṣṇāghnaṃ dīpanīyaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ kṣīṇakṣateṣu ca

hindi: यह विशेष रूप से पाण्डुरोग, अम्लपित्त, शोष, गुल्म और उदररोग में, तथा अतिसार, ज्वर, दाह और शोथ में हितकर है।
english: It is especially (beneficial) in anaemia (pāṇḍu-roga), acid dyspepsia (amlapitta), wasting (śoṣa), abdominal lump (gulma) and abdominal enlargement (udara), and in diarrhoea (atīsāra), fever, burning sensation and swelling (śvayathu).
notes: The verb ('is beneficial') is implied from the context of 109. Modern equivalents are the usual approximations: pāṇḍu = anaemia; amlapitta = hyperacidity; śoṣa = consumption/wasting; gulma = abdominal lump or tumour; udara = abdominal enlargement including ascites.
lines_deva: अतीसारे ज्वरे दाहे श्वयथौ च विशेषतः
lines_iast: atīsāre jvare dāhe śvayathau ca viśeṣataḥ

words.gloss: in disorders of vagina and semen

hindi: योनि और शुक्र के दोषों में, अल्प मूत्र में और गाँठदार कठोर मल में यह हितकर है, तथा वात और पित्त के विकारों से पीड़ित लोगों के लिए पथ्य है।
english: In disorders of the female genital tract (yoni) and of semen (śukra), in scanty urine, and in hard, knotted faeces, it is wholesome for those suffering from Vāta and Pitta disorders.
notes: yoni here may be the female reproductive organ generally; pradoṣa = disorder/vitiation.

words.gloss: in nasal therapy, plasters and baths

hindi: नस्य, लेप, अवगाहन, वमन, आस्थापन, विरेचन और स्नेहन में, सब जगह दूध का प्रयोग होता है।
english: In nasal therapy (nasya), plasters, immersion baths, emesis (vamana), decoction enemas (āsthāpana), purgation (virecana) and oleation (snehana): milk is used everywhere.
lines_deva: विरेचने स्नेहने च पयः सर्वत्र युज्यते
lines_iast: virecane snehane ca payaḥ sarvatra yujyate

hindi: हर एक के दूध के गुणों को अलग-अलग क्रम से मैं अन्नपान आदि वाले अध्याय में फिर पूरी तरह कहूँगा।
english: The properties of the milk of each (animal), one by one and in due order, I shall describe again in full in the chapter beginning with 'annapāna' (food and drink).
notes: ekaikasya 'of each' refers to the milk-giving animals listed earlier. The chapter meant is probably Sūtrasthāna 27 (Annapānavidhi); that is an inference, the text gives only the title phrase.

words.gloss: from the fruit- and root-yielding plants

hindi: अब तीन अन्य वृक्ष हैं, जो फलिनी और मूलिनी द्रव्यों से अलग हैं: स्नुही, अर्क और अश्मन्तक। उनका कर्म अलग-अलग इस प्रकार है।
english: Now there are three other trees, separate from the fruit- and root-yielding plants: snuhī, arka and aśmantaka. Their action, one by one, is as follows.
notes: Identifications: snuhī = Euphorbia neriifolia, Hindi थूहर/सेहुंड (standard); arka = Calotropis procera or C. gigantea, Hindi आक/मदार (standard); aśmantaka = disputed (Bauhinia racemosa and Ficus species have been proposed).

hindi: वमन में अश्मन्तक को जानना चाहिए, विरेचन में स्नुही के दूध को; और अर्क का दूध विरेचन सहित वमन में जानना चाहिए।
english: One should know aśmantaka (as used) for emesis and the latex of snuhī for purgation; the latex of arka is to be known (as used) for emesis together with purgation.
notes: kṣīra here means the plant latex, not milk. 'vamane savirecane' read as 'in emesis accompanied by purgation', i.e. arka latex acts both ways.

hindi: इन तीन अन्य वृक्षों को बताते हैं जिनकी छालें हितकर हैं: पूतीक, कृष्णगन्धा और तिल्वक वृक्ष।
english: They name these three other trees whose barks are beneficial: pūtīka, kṛṣṇagandhā and likewise the tree tilvaka.
notes: Identifications: pūtīka = disputed (Holoptelea integrifolia and pūtikarañja, Caesalpinia bonduc, are both proposed); kṛṣṇagandhā = probable Moringa oleifera, drumstick, Hindi सहजन (identified with śigru by commentators); tilvaka = disputed (Symplocos racemosa, lodhra, and Viburnum species proposed).
lines_deva: पूतीकः कृष्णगन्धा च तिल्वकश्च तथा तरुः
lines_iast: pūtīkaḥ kṛṣṇagandhā ca tilvakaśca tathā taruḥ

hindi: विरेचन में पूतीक और तिल्वक का प्रयोग करना चाहिए; कृष्णगन्धा परीसर्प, शोथ और अर्श में बताई गई है।
english: Pūtīka and likewise tilvaka are to be used for purgation; kṛṣṇagandhā is prescribed in spreading skin disease (parīsarpa), in swellings and in piles (arśas),

text_flags.why: possible spelling error: loc. pl. of arśas is arśaḥsu (no retroflex ṣ after a-visarga); sense and metre unaffected

notes: The list of diseases for kṛṣṇagandhā continues into unit 118 (sentence continuation, grouping is correct). parīsarpa = visarpa, usually equated with erysipelas (approximate).

words.gloss: in ringworm, abscess and glandular swellings

hindi: दद्रु, विद्रधि, गण्ड, कुष्ठ और अलजी में भी; और विवेकशील व्यक्ति इन छह वृक्षों को शोधन करने वाला भी जाने।
english: and in ringworm (dadru), abscess (vidradhi), glandular swellings (gaṇḍa), skin diseases (kuṣṭha) and alajī eruptions. The discerning (physician) should also know these six trees as purifying (śodhana).
notes: Line a continues the diseases for kṛṣṇagandhā from unit 117. gaṇḍa may mean goitre or glandular swelling; kuṣṭha covers skin diseases broadly, not only leprosy; alajī is a kind of boil or eruption (exact sense varies between texts).

words.gloss: whose latex and bark were indicated

hindi: इस प्रकार फलिनी और मूलिनी द्रव्य, स्नेह, लवण, मूत्र, दूध और वे छह वृक्ष जिनके दूध और छाल बताए गए हैं, कह दिए गए।
english: Thus have been stated the fruit- and root-yielding plants, the unctuous substances (sneha), the salts, urine, the milks, and the six trees whose latex and bark were indicated.
notes: diṣṭa-payas-tvacaḥ: three trees are used for their latex (payas) and three for their bark (tvak).
lines_deva: मूत्रं क्षीराणि वृक्षाश्च षड् ये दिष्टपयस्त्वचः
lines_iast: mūtraṃ kṣīrāṇi vṛkṣāśca ṣaḍ ye diṣṭapayastvacaḥ

hindi: वन में बकरी चराने वाले, भेड़ चराने वाले, गोपालक और जो अन्य वनवासी हैं, वे ओषधियों को नाम और रूप से जानते हैं।
english: Goatherds, shepherds, cowherds and the other forest-dwellers know the plants in the forest by their names and forms.
notes: vane may go with jānate ('know in the forest') or with the herdsmen ('herdsmen in the forest'); the sense is the same.

hindi: केवल नाम के ज्ञान से, या फिर रूप के ज्ञान से, कोई भी ओषधियों की परम प्राप्ति को नहीं जान सकता।
english: No one can know the highest mastery of plants by mere knowledge of their names, or again by knowledge of their forms.
notes: parāṃ prāptim 'highest attainment' is taken as full mastery of the plants (their right use); it could also be read as 'the highest benefit obtained from plants'.

hindi: परन्तु जो उनके प्रयोग को जानता है, वह रूप को न जानते हुए भी उनका तत्त्व जानने वाला कहलाता है; फिर उस वैद्य का तो कहना ही क्या जो ओषधियों को सब प्रकार से जानता हो।
english: But one who knows their application (yoga), even without knowing their form, is called a knower of their true nature; how much more, then, the physician who knows the plants in every respect!

hindi: जो वैद्य प्रत्येक व्यक्ति की परीक्षा करके देश और काल के अनुसार इनके प्रयोग को जानता है, उसे उत्तम वैद्य जानना चाहिए।
english: He who knows their application, adapted to place and time, after examining each person individually, is to be known as the best of physicians.
notes: puruṣaṃ puruṣam (repetition) = each individual person.
lines_deva: पुरुषं पुरुषं वीक्ष्य स ज्ञेयो भिषगुत्तमः
lines_iast: puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ vīkṣya sa jñeyo bhiṣaguttamaḥ

hindi: जैसे विष, जैसे शस्त्र, जैसे अग्नि, जैसे वज्र होता है, वैसी ही बिना जानी हुई औषध होती है; और जानी हुई औषध अमृत के समान होती है।
english: Like poison, like a weapon, like fire, like a thunderbolt is a medicine that is not understood; a medicine well understood is like nectar (amṛta).

hindi: क्योंकि जो औषध नाम, रूप और गुण इन तीनों से न पहचानी गई हो, और जो जानी हुई होकर भी गलत ढंग से प्रयुक्त हो, वह अनर्थ का कारण बनती है।
english: For a medicine not recognised by the three, name, form and properties, and even one that is known but wrongly applied, leads to harm.

hindi: उचित प्रयोग से तीक्ष्ण विष भी उत्तम औषध बन सकता है, और गलत ढंग से प्रयुक्त औषध भी तीक्ष्ण विष बन जाती है।
english: Through proper application even a potent poison may become an excellent medicine, and a medicine wrongly applied becomes a potent poison.
notes: tīkṣṇa in line a may qualify viṣam ('potent poison') as taken here; grammatically it could also go with bheṣajam.
lines_deva: भेषजं चापि दुर्युक्तं तीक्ष्णं संपद्यते विषम्
lines_iast: bheṣajaṃ cāpi duryuktaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ saṃpadyate viṣam

hindi: इसलिए जीवन और आरोग्य चाहने वाले बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति को युक्ति से रहित वैद्य द्वारा दी गई कोई भी औषध नहीं लेनी चाहिए।
english: Therefore a wise person who desires life and health should not accept any medicine administered by a physician who is devoid of rational planning (yukti).
notes: yukti = reasoned planning of treatment; yukti-bāhya lit. 'outside yukti'.

hindi: सिर पर गिरा हुआ इन्द्र का वज्र भी शायद कुछ शेष छोड़ दे, परन्तु अज्ञानी द्वारा बताई गई औषध रोगी को कुछ भी शेष नहीं छोड़ती।
english: Vāsava's (Indra's) thunderbolt falling on the head might still leave something remaining; but a medicine prescribed by an ignorant person would not leave the patient with anything remaining.
notes: saśeṣa 'with a remainder' = left with some life. ajña-mata lit. 'thought fit by an ignorant one'.

words.gram: m. dat. sg. pres. part. śrad-√dhā

hindi: जो अपने को बुद्धिमान मानने वाला व्यक्ति औषध को बिना जाने दुःखी, शय्या पर पड़े, श्रद्धा रखने वाले रोगी को दे देता है,
english: He who, thinking himself wise, gives a medicine without knowing it to a suffering, bed-ridden and trusting patient,
notes: The sentence continues into unit 130 (the yaḥ of this verse is picked up by tasya there); grouping is correct.

words.gloss: of one who has abandoned dharma

hindi: उस धर्म को त्याग देने वाले, पापी, मृत्यु रूप, दुर्बुद्धि व्यक्ति से बात करने मात्र से भी मनुष्य नरक में गिरने वाला हो जाता है।
english: with that man, who has abandoned dharma, sinful, death incarnate, evil-minded, a person would fall into hell even by conversing.
notes: Completes the sentence begun in unit 129.

hindi: साँप का विष पी लेना, या उबला हुआ पिघला ताँबा पी लेना, अथवा तीव्र आग में तपाए हुए लोहे के गोले निगल लेना अच्छा है,
english: Better to drink a serpent's venom or boiled (molten) copper, or even to swallow iron balls heated in fierce fire,
notes: Sentence continues into unit 132 ('but not ...'). The visarga of bhakṣitāḥ and of -santaptāḥ is dropped by sandhi before a voiced sound.

words.gloss: from one who has come for refuge

hindi: परन्तु विद्वानों का वेश धारण करने वाले व्यक्ति द्वारा शरण में आए हुए रोगपीड़ित से अन्न, पान या धन लेना अच्छा नहीं है।
english: but not (better) is food, drink or money taken, by one who wears the guise of the learned, from a disease-stricken person who has come to him for refuge.
notes: natu printed as one token = na tu. The predicate 'better' (varam) from unit 131 is understood: worse than those deadly acts is taking food, drink or wealth from a sick refugee while wearing the guise of the learned.
lines_deva: गृहीतमन्नं पानं वा वित्तं वा रोगपीडितात्
lines_iast: gṛhītamannaṃ pānaṃ vā vittaṃ vā rogapīḍitāt

hindi: इसलिए वैद्य बनने की इच्छा रखने वाला बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति अपने गुणों की सम्पदा प्राप्त करने में परम प्रयत्न करे, जिससे वह मनुष्यों का प्राणदाता हो सके।
english: Therefore an intelligent person wishing to become a physician should make the utmost effort to perfect his own qualities, so that he may be a giver of life to people.

hindi: वही औषध उचित है जो आरोग्य प्रदान करे, और वही वैद्यों में श्रेष्ठ है जो रोगों से मुक्त कर दे।
english: That alone is the proper medicine which brings about health, and he alone is the best of physicians who frees (people) from diseases.
lines_deva: स चैव भिषजां श्रेष्ठो रोगेभ्यो यः प्रमोचयेत्
lines_iast: sa caiva bhiṣajāṃ śreṣṭho rogebhyo yaḥ pramocayet

hindi: सिद्धि सब कर्मों के सही प्रयोग को बताती है, और सिद्धि सब गुणों से युक्त श्रेष्ठ वैद्य को बताती है।
english: Success reveals the correct application of all therapeutic actions; and success reveals the best physician, endowed with all qualities.
notes: karman here = therapeutic procedure (karma = action per glossary).

hindi: यहाँ ये श्लोक हैं: आयुर्वेद का आगमन, उसके आगमन का कारण, उसका प्रवर्तन, सूत्ररचना का अनुमोदन, आयुर्वेद का निर्णय,
english: Here are the verses: the coming of Āyurveda (the science of life), the reason for its coming, its propagation, the approval of the composition (of treatises), the definition of Āyurveda,
notes: 'tatra ślokāḥ' is the lead-in formula of the closing summary; it is kept as line a of this numbered verse as the edition groups it. The list (a catalogue of topics in nom.) runs on to unit 140.

hindi: पूर्ण कारण, कार्य, आयुर्वेद का प्रयोजन, रोगों के हेतु, दोष और संक्षेप में औषध,
english: the complete cause (kāraṇa), the effect (kārya), the purpose of Āyurveda, the causes (of disease), the doṣas and, in brief, medicine,
notes: saṃpūrṇaṃ kāraṇam probably refers to the six fundamental causes (sāmānya, viśeṣa, guṇa, dravya, karma, samavāya) treated in the chapter; this is an interpretation. saṃgraheṇa 'in brief' may qualify only bheṣajam or the whole list.

words.gloss: with the substances that are their source

hindi: रस, उनके आश्रय रूप द्रव्यों सहित, द्रव्यों का तीन प्रकार का संग्रह, मूलिनी और फलिनी द्रव्य, स्नेह और लवण,
english: the tastes (rasa) together with the substances that are their source, the threefold classification of substances, the root-yielding and fruit-yielding plants, the unctuous substances and the salts,
notes: sa-pratyaya-dravyāḥ is uncertain: 'with their causes, the substances' or 'with the substances that are their basis (pratyaya)'; the second is taken here.

words.gloss: merits and demerits of proper and improper use

hindi: मूत्र, दूध, और वे छह वृक्ष जिनका उपयोग दूध और छाल पर आधारित है, इन सबके कर्म, और उचित तथा अनुचित प्रयोग के गुण और दोष,
english: urine, the milks, the six trees whose use rests on latex and bark, the actions of all these, the merits of proper use and the faults of improper use,
notes: yoga-ayoga-guṇa-aguṇāḥ may also be read as four items: proper use, improper use, merits, demerits.
lines_deva: मूत्रं क्षीराणि वृक्षाश्च षड् ये क्षीरत्वगाश्रयाः
lines_iast: mūtraṃ kṣīrāṇi vṛkṣāśca ṣaḍ ye kṣīratvagāśrayāḥ

hindi: वैद्य की निन्दा, और जहाँ वैद्यों के सब गुण स्थित हैं, यह सब महर्षि ने पहले अध्याय में भली भाँति कहा है।
english: the censure of physicians, and (the passage) where all the qualities of physicians are found: all this has been explained by the great sage in the first chapter.
notes: yatrasthāḥ 'located where' is elliptical: the verses in which all the physician's qualities are stated. The great sage is not named here.
lines_deva: वैद्यापवादो यत्रस्थाः सर्वे च भिषजां गुणाः
lines_iast: vaidyāpavādo yatrasthāḥ sarve ca bhiṣajāṃ guṇāḥ

hindi: इस प्रकार अग्निवेश द्वारा रचित और चरक द्वारा प्रतिसंस्कृत तन्त्र के सूत्रस्थान में दीर्घञ्जीवितीय नामक पहला अध्याय।
english: Thus, in the Sūtrasthāna of the treatise composed by Agniveśa and redacted by Caraka, the first chapter, named Dīrghañjīvitīya (On long life).
notes: Chapter colophon. The title is taken from the chapter's opening words (dīrghaṃ jīvitam). The Sanskrit has no verb; the translation keeps it verbless.
lines_deva: इत्यग्निवेशकृते तन्त्रे चरकप्रतिसंस्कृते सूत्रस्थाने दीर्घञ्जीवितीयो नाम प्रथमोऽध्यायः
lines_iast: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte sūtrasthāne dīrghañjīvitīyo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
